text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. If anything... I'm totally 
fired up.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I've been pretty pathetic lately, haven't 
I? That's why I have to do this."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Properly giving back what was given to me— 
I'll do what should come naturally with 
everything I've got...!
